Messages.Author: Jeff Poole
Messages.Body:
First off, let me start by stating I hate the imbued. It's a pure
fluff thing.

Secondly,if you play by the rules how do you square people playing
Imbued? (especially in tournament play)

Nowhere in the rule book (online or in the most current printed
version) does it define things such as Powers, Convictions, Creeds,
Virtues, the Incapacitated Region, etc.

These terms are only defined here:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Checklist_NightsOfReckoning
which is not in the rule book (online or print) nor in the Official
Tournament Rules.

It does say under the official tournament rules that you can use the
rule cards from Night of Reckoning (Sec 4.1) but I assume this means
you can use them as library cards (ex. Elder Library). It would see
the only way to use, for instance, the incapacitated region, would be
to draw the rule card then play it (somehow).

The only reason I bring this up is I would like to see these rules
incorporated into the rule book. There are rules such as infernal,
circle, blood cursed and such in the rule book; why does the Nights of
Reckoning set's "rules" have to be left out of the rules. It seems
the only reason these rules have been left out of the rule book for 7
expansions is that they were never intended for tournament play.

Sorry for being a nuisance, but I was just thinking about how much
this discrepancy and thought I would ask LSJ about why the rules have
been set up this way.

Jeff Poole

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Feb 25, 8:12 pm, Jeff Poole <Perrin...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Nowhere in the rule book (online or in the most current printed
> version) does it define things such as Powers, Convictions, Creeds,
> Virtues, the Incapacitated Region, etc.

The five NoR rules cards are part of the body of rules.
They're also mentioned in the most current printed rulebook and linked
in the online rulebook. [1.5]
